title: How to Introduce Yourself in English | Daily Conversation for Beginners | English Podcast

subtitles.en:
Hello everyone! Welcome back to... the AB
English Podcast. I'm Mia, and—oh—I'm so happy
you're joining us today!
subtitles.zh:
大家好！歡迎回到我們的英語廣播節目。我是 Mia，
噢，我真的好高興大家今天能加入我們！

subtitles.en:
And I'm Alex. It's great to be here! Well...
how are you doing today, Mia? Wow, you look
very energetic!
subtitles.zh:
我是 Alex。很高興來到這裡！嗯……妳今天好嗎，
Mia？哇，妳看起來活力充沛呢！

subtitles.en:
I'm doing great! But... actually, I had a bit
of a funny—yet slightly awkward—experience at
a party last weekend.
subtitles.zh:
我很好呀！不過……其實我上週末在一個派對上，
遇到了一件滿有趣但也有一點點尷尬的事情。

subtitles.en:
Oh? What happened? Did you meet someone
interesting?
subtitles.zh: 喔？發生了什麼事？妳遇到什麼有趣的人嗎？

subtitles.en:
I did! But... when a new friend looked at me
and asked, "So, tell me about yourself," my
mind suddenly... went completely blank!
subtitles.zh:
沒錯！但當一位新朋友看著我並問說：「那麼，
聊聊妳自己吧。」我的大腦突然……一片空白！

subtitles.en:
Well, that happens to almost everyone!
Honestly... even in our native language, it
can be a really tricky question.
subtitles.zh:
哎呀，這種事幾乎每個人都會遇到！老實說……即使是用我們的母語，
這也可能是一個非常棘手的問題。

subtitles.en:
Exactly! I panicked... and started talking
about how many eggs I ate for breakfast, and
then—silence. Oh, it was so embarrassing!
subtitles.zh:
沒錯！我當時慌了……居然開始聊起我早餐吃了幾顆蛋，
接著就是——一陣死寂。天啊，真的超級尷尬的！

subtitles.en:
Haha! In social situations... being asked
that out of nowhere can really catch you off
guard.
subtitles.zh: 哈哈！在社交場合上……突然被問到這個問題，真的會讓人措手不及。

subtitles.en:
That is so true! And... well, that is exactly
why we are here today.
subtitles.zh: 真的就是這樣！而這……嗯，這也正是我們今天聚在這裡的原因。

subtitles.en:
That's right! We want to make self-
introductions feel... as simple, natural, and
fun as chatting with a good friend.
subtitles.zh:
沒錯！我們想讓自我介紹感覺起來……就像和好朋友聊天一樣簡單、
自然又有趣。

subtitles.en:
Oh, before we dive into our practice... here
are two great features of our channel for all
our new learners!
subtitles.zh:
噢，在我們深入練習之前……這裡有我們頻道的兩個超棒特色，
要分享給所有的新學習者！

subtitles.en:
First... we provide human-accurate captions
in twenty-nine different languages for every
single video!
subtitles.zh: 第一……我們為每一支影片都提供了人工校對、精確無誤的二十九種語言字幕！

subtitles.en:
Yes! Make sure to turn on the subtitles in
your native language... so you can understand
with zero stress!
subtitles.zh: 沒錯！請一定要開啟你母語的字幕……這樣你就能毫無壓力地聽懂囉！

subtitles.en:
Second... our dynamic English and Chinese on-
screen subtitles let you easily read
along—while listening!
subtitles.zh:
第二……我們畫面上的動態中英字幕，能讓你在聽的同時，
非常輕鬆地跟著閱讀！

subtitles.en:
That is our core philosophy—Always Better
Everyday!
subtitles.zh: 這就是我們的核心理念——每天都要變得更好！

subtitles.en:
And to make your learning even better... we
provide two amazing, completely free practice
tools for our fans!
subtitles.zh:
而且為了讓你的學習效果更上一層樓……我們還為粉絲們準備了兩個超棒、
而且完全免費的練習工具！

subtitles.en:
That's right! After this video, you can use
our special dictation learning player...
which is designed with multiple powerful
learning modes.
subtitles.zh:
沒錯！看完整支影片後，你可以使用我們特別的聽寫學習播放器……它設計了多
種強大的學習模式。

subtitles.en:
You can use A-B loops for intensive
listening... blind listening to train your
ears, and typing dictation to test your
memory.
subtitles.zh:
你可以使用段落循環來進行精聽練習……用盲聽模式來訓練耳朵，
還能用打字聽寫來測試自己的記憶力。

subtitles.en:
Wow, it even features a voice validation
mode! You can speak directly into the
microphone, and... well, the system will
instantly verify your pronunciation.
subtitles.zh:
哇，它甚至還有語音驗證模式！你可以直接對著麥克風說話，
然後……嗯，系統就會即時驗證你的發音。

subtitles.en:
Yes! You can also use our AI conversation
tutor to practice one-on-one speaking with
AI... using the exact vocabulary from today's
lesson!
subtitles.zh:
沒錯！你還可以使用我們的人工智慧對話導師，
和人工智慧進行一對一的口說練習……而且用的就是我們今天課堂上學到的單字
！

subtitles.en:
Both tools are completely free with no login
required... at all! You can find the links in
the description box below.
subtitles.zh:
這兩款工具都完全免費，而且……根本不需要登入！
你可以在下方的說明欄裡找到連結。

subtitles.en:
So... Alex, are you ready to help everyone
practice self-introductions today?
subtitles.zh: 那麼……Alex，你準備好今天來幫大家練習自我介紹了嗎？

subtitles.en: Oh, I am definitely ready. Let's get started!
subtitles.zh: 噢，我絕對準備好了。我們開始吧！

subtitles.en: So, Mia... why don't you demonstrate first?
subtitles.zh: 那麼，Mia……妳要不要先來示範一下？

subtitles.en:
Sure! Let's start with the simplest first
step... "What is your name?"
subtitles.zh: 好啊！我們就從最簡單的第一步開始……「你叫什麼名字？」

subtitles.en: My name is Mia... M-I-A.
subtitles.zh: 我的名字是 Mia……字母拼寫是 M-I-A。

subtitles.en:
Nice to meet you, Mia! My name is Alex...
A-L-E-X.
subtitles.zh:
很高興認識妳，Mia！我的名字是 Alex……字母拼寫是 A-L-E-
X。

subtitles.en:
Well, spelling out your name makes it much
easier for others to remember!
subtitles.zh: 嗯，把名字拼出來會讓別人更容易記住喔！

subtitles.en:
That's right! The next natural question is...
"Where are you from?"
subtitles.zh: 沒錯！下一個自然而然會問的問題就是……「你來自哪裡？」

subtitles.en:
I am from Canada! Hmm... what about you,
Alex?
subtitles.zh: 我來自加拿大！嗯……那你呢，Alex？

subtitles.en: Well, I am from the United States.
subtitles.zh: 噢，我來自美國。

subtitles.en:
Oh, the United States! Many people then
ask... "Do you live in a big city?"
subtitles.zh: 喔，美國呀！那很多人接著就會問……「你住在一個大城市嗎？」

subtitles.en: Yes, I live in a big city.
subtitles.zh: 是的，我住在一個大城市。

subtitles.en:
Hmm... living in a big city is convenient,
but... is it noisy?
subtitles.zh: 嗯……住在城市雖然很方便，但是……會不會很吵呢？

subtitles.en:
It's busy and loud, yes... but I love the
energy—and the late-night cafes! What about
you?
subtitles.zh:
沒錯，確實很忙碌又嘈雜……但我好喜歡那種活力，
還有那些開到很晚的咖啡廳！那你呢？

subtitles.en:
Well, I live in a small town. It's very...
quiet and peaceful.
subtitles.zh: 噢，我住在一個小鎮。那裡非常……安靜而且祥和。

subtitles.en:
Oh, a small town? Do you... do you like it
there?
subtitles.zh: 喔，小鎮嗎？那你……喜歡那裡嗎？

subtitles.en:
I do. I really enjoy... well, the calm
lifestyle.
subtitles.zh: 喜歡啊。我真的很享受……嗯，這種平靜的生活步調。

subtitles.en:
That sounds so peaceful. Hmm... do you live
in a house, or an apartment?
subtitles.zh: 那聽起來好祥和。嗯……你是住在一棟房子，還是公寓裡呢？

subtitles.en:
I live in a small house... with a beautiful
garden.
subtitles.zh: 我住在一棟小房子裡……還附帶一個漂亮的花園。

subtitles.en: Oh, a garden! I... I love gardens so much.
subtitles.zh: 喔，是花園！我……我最喜歡花園了。

subtitles.en:
On weekends, I just love taking care of my
plants. What about you, Mia?
subtitles.zh: 在週末，我最喜歡照顧我的植物了。妳呢，Mia？

subtitles.en:
Well... I actually live in an apartment
downtown.
subtitles.zh: 這個嘛……我其實住在市中心的一間公寓裡。

subtitles.en: Oh? Is it... a big apartment?
subtitles.zh: 哦？那是一間……很大的公寓嗎？

subtitles.en:
No, it's a small apartment—but it's very nice
and cozy!
subtitles.zh: 不，那是一間小公寓——但非常漂亮而且很溫馨！

subtitles.en:
That's lovely! Well... what about age? People
often ask, "Alex, how old are you?"
subtitles.zh: 那太棒了！嗯……那年齡呢？大家常問：『Alex，你幾歲了？』

subtitles.en: Well, I am 28 years old. What about you, Mia?
subtitles.zh: 嗯，我今年二十八歲。妳呢，Mia？

subtitles.en: I am 25 years old!
subtitles.zh: 我今年二十五歲！

subtitles.en: Oh, 25! That is... a truly wonderful age.
subtitles.zh: 喔，二十五歲！那真的是……一個非常美好的年紀。

subtitles.en:
Now... for a big question in social
situations!
subtitles.zh: 現在……要來問一個社交場合的經典大問題了！

subtitles.en: Oh, I'm ready! What is it?
subtitles.zh: 喔，我準備好了！是什麼問題？

subtitles.en: What do you do, Alex?
subtitles.zh: 你是做什麼工作的，Alex？

subtitles.en:
Ah, this is such an important question!
Beginners often confuse it with... "what are
you doing right now?"
subtitles.zh:
啊，這真的是個非常重要的問題！初學者常常會把它跟『你現在正在做什麼』搞
混。

subtitles.en:
Exactly! But it actually means... "what is
your job?"
subtitles.zh: 沒錯！但它其實是指……『你的職業是什麼？』

subtitles.en:
Well, I am an English teacher... on our
podcast!
subtitles.zh: 嗯，我是一位英文老師……在我們的播客節目上！

subtitles.en:
And Alex is... a very patient and friendly
teacher!
subtitles.zh: 而且 Alex 是一位……非常耐心且友善的老師喔！

subtitles.en:
Oh, thank you! I truly love my job
because—well, I get to help people improve
every day! What about you, Mia?
subtitles.zh:
喔，謝謝妳！我真的很熱愛我的工作，因為——嗯，
我每天都能幫助大家進步！那妳呢，Mia？

subtitles.en:
I am a student! I am currently studying... at
university.
subtitles.zh: 我是一名學生！目前正在……大學就讀。

subtitles.en: Oh, a student! What do you study?
subtitles.zh: 喔，是學生呀！那妳主修什麼呢？

subtitles.en:
I study art! I just love to draw... and paint
pictures.
subtitles.zh: 我學藝術！我就是很喜歡畫畫……還有繪製圖畫。

subtitles.en:
Art! Wow, that is so creative. Do you...
enjoy your studies?
subtitles.zh: 藝術！哇，那真的很有創意。妳……喜歡妳的學業嗎？

subtitles.en:
Yes, I love it! It's really fun... and
inspiring.
subtitles.zh: 是的，我非常喜歡！這真的很有趣……而且很能激發靈感。

subtitles.en:
An art student and an English teacher—we make
a great team!
subtitles.zh: 一位藝術系學生和一位英文老師——我們真是個絕佳的組合！

subtitles.en:
You know... after talking about jobs, sharing
family details really brings people closer
together.
subtitles.zh: 妳知道嗎……在聊完工作後，分享家庭的細節真的能讓彼此的距離更拉近一步。

subtitles.en:
So true! Do you have any brothers or sisters,
Mia?
subtitles.zh: 確實如此！那 Mia，妳有任何兄弟姊妹嗎？

subtitles.en: Yes, I have one brother. His name is Tom.
subtitles.zh: 有的，我有一個哥哥。他的名字叫 Tom。

subtitles.en: Oh, is Tom... older or younger than you?
subtitles.zh: 喔，那 Tom……比妳大還是比妳小呢？

subtitles.en: He is older. He is... 29 years old.
subtitles.zh: 他比較大。他今年……二十九歲。

subtitles.en: Oh! So... he is one year older than me!
subtitles.zh: 喔！所以……他只比我大一歲呢！

subtitles.en:
Yes, exactly! What about you, Alex? Do you
have... any siblings?
subtitles.zh: 沒錯，就是這樣！那你呢，Alex？你有……任何兄弟姊妹嗎？

subtitles.en: Yes, I have one sister. Her name is Sarah.
subtitles.zh: 有的，我有一個妹妹。她的名字叫 Sarah。

subtitles.en: Oh, is Sarah... a student too?
subtitles.zh: 喔，那 Sarah……也是學生嗎？

subtitles.en:
Yes, she studies music. She plays the
piano... very well!
subtitles.zh: 是的，她主修音樂。她的鋼琴彈得……非常棒！

subtitles.en:
A music student! Wow, that is so wonderful.
What about... your parents?
subtitles.zh: 音樂系學生！哇，那真是太棒了。那……你的父母呢？

subtitles.en:
Well, my mother is a children's book author,
and my father is a doctor... in a hospital.
subtitles.zh: 嗯，我母親是一位童書作家，而我父親是一位醫生……在醫院工作。

subtitles.en:
Oh, a writer and a doctor! You have such a
wonderful family, Alex!
subtitles.zh: 喔，一位作家和一位醫生！Alex，你有一個這麼棒的家庭！

subtitles.en: Thank you. What about... your parents, Mia?
subtitles.zh: 謝謝妳。那……妳的父母呢，Mia？

subtitles.en:
Well, my mother is an elementary school
teacher, and my father is a chef... in a
restaurant!
subtitles.zh: 嗯，我母親是一位小學老師，而我父親是一位主廚……在餐廳工作！

subtitles.en:
Oh, a chef! Wow, does he cook delicious meals
for you... at home?
subtitles.zh: 喔，主廚！哇，那他在家裡會做美味的料理給妳吃嗎？

subtitles.en:
Yes, he does! The food is always...
absolutely amazing!
subtitles.zh: 會啊，他會做！他做的食物總是……超級無敵美味！

subtitles.en:
Oh, I am so jealous! That... sounds
absolutely delicious.
subtitles.zh: 喔，我好羨慕喔！那……聽起來真的好好吃。

subtitles.en:
Now, how about pets? ...Do you have any pets,
Alex?
subtitles.zh: 現在，聊聊寵物吧！……你有養寵物嗎，Alex？

subtitles.en: Oh, yes! I have a dog. His name is Max.
subtitles.zh: 喔，有啊！我有一隻狗。他的名字叫 Max。

subtitles.en: Max! Oh... what kind of dog is he?
subtitles.zh: Max！喔……他是什麼樣的狗呢？

subtitles.en:
Well, he is a small brown dog. He is super
playful—and always wagging his tail happily!
subtitles.zh: 嗯，他是一隻棕色的小狗。他超級愛玩——而且總是快樂地搖著尾巴！

subtitles.en:
Aw, he sounds so cute! I... I really want to
meet Max someday!
subtitles.zh: 啊，聽起來好可愛喔！我……我真的好想有一天能見到 Max！

subtitles.en:
Maybe you can! What about you, Mia? Do you...
do you have a pet?
subtitles.zh: 也許有機會喔！那妳呢，Mia？妳……妳有養寵物嗎？

subtitles.en: Yes! I have a cat. Her name is... Luna.
subtitles.zh: 有啊！我有一隻貓。她的名字叫……Luna。

subtitles.en: Luna! Oh, what does she look like?
subtitles.zh: Luna！喔，她長什麼樣子呢？

subtitles.en:
She is a black and white cat. She is very
quiet... and loves sleeping in sunny spots
all day!
subtitles.zh:
她是一隻黑白相間的貓。她非常安靜……而且最喜歡整天在陽光普照的地方睡覺
！

subtitles.en:
A cat that loves naps—now that sounds like a
classic cat life!
subtitles.zh: 一隻愛睡午覺的貓——這聽起來真是經典的貓咪生活啊！

subtitles.en:
Haha, it really is! She has... a wonderful
life.
subtitles.zh: 哈哈，真的！她過著……非常美好的生活。

subtitles.en:
Now, let's talk about our favorite things!
...Starting with food: What is your favorite
food?
subtitles.zh: 現在，我們來聊聊最喜歡的事物吧！……首先是食物：你最喜歡的食物是什麼？

subtitles.en: Hmm... I think my favorite food is pizza!
subtitles.zh: 嗯……我想我最喜歡的食物是披薩！

subtitles.en:
Pizza! Oh, that's a classic choice. What...
what toppings do you like?
subtitles.zh: 披薩！喔，那真是經典的選擇。你喜歡……喜歡加什麼配料呢？

subtitles.en:
I love vegetable pizza—with peppers,
tomatoes, and extra cheese! What about you?
subtitles.zh: 我超愛蔬菜披薩——上面有青椒、番茄和滿滿的起司！那妳呢？

subtitles.en:
Well, I love pepperoni pizza... but my number
one favorite is definitely pasta!
subtitles.zh: 嗯，我喜歡義式臘腸披薩……但我心目中的第一名絕對是義大利麵！

subtitles.en:
Oh, pasta is delicious! ...So, what is your
favorite color?
subtitles.zh: 喔，義大利麵太好吃了！……那麼，妳最喜歡的顏色是什麼？

subtitles.en:
My favorite color is green—like the trees and
grass in nature. What about you?
subtitles.zh: 我最喜歡的顏色是綠色——就像大自然中的樹木和青草。你呢？

subtitles.en:
My favorite color is blue. It feels... calm,
like the ocean and the sky.
subtitles.zh: 我最喜歡的顏色是藍色。它給人一種……平靜的感覺，就像大海和天空一樣。

subtitles.en:
What are your hobbies, Alex? I mean... what
do you do for fun?
subtitles.zh: 你的興趣是什麼，Alex？我是說……你平常都做些什麼娛樂？

subtitles.en: Oh, I love listening to classic rock music!
subtitles.zh: 喔，我超愛聽經典搖滾樂！

subtitles.en:
Rock music! Wow, very cool. Do you... play
sports too?
subtitles.zh: 搖滾樂！哇，太酷了。那你……也做運動嗎？

subtitles.en:
Yes! I play soccer with my friends every
Saturday. It... keeps me energetic! What
about you, Mia?
subtitles.zh:
對啊！我每個星期六都會和朋友一起踢足球。這……讓我保持活力！
那妳呢，Mia？

subtitles.en:
Well, besides painting, I love reading
adventure books... and watching animated
movies!
subtitles.zh: 嗯，除了畫畫之外，我還喜歡讀冒險故事書……還有看動畫電影！

subtitles.en:
Animated movies have so much imagination! But
I love comedy movies... because, well, I love
laughing.
subtitles.zh: 動畫電影真的好有想像力！但我最愛喜劇電影……因為，嗯，我喜歡開懷大笑。

subtitles.en:
Laughing is the best medicine! Oh, I love
comedies too!
subtitles.zh: 笑是最好的良藥！喔，我也超愛喜劇的！

subtitles.en:
You know, talking about things we dislike can
actually be... even more fun and relatable!
subtitles.zh: 妳知道嗎，聊聊我們討厭的事情，其實……可能更好玩也更容易引起共鳴喔！

subtitles.en:
That's so true! Alex... what is a food you
dislike?
subtitles.zh: 真的耶！Alex……有什麼食物是你討厭的嗎？

subtitles.en:
Oh, I do not like olives. I... I really
cannot stand the taste!
subtitles.zh: 喔，我不喜歡橄欖。我……我真的無法忍受那個味道！

subtitles.en: Olives? Really? ...I actually love olives!
subtitles.zh: 橄欖？真的嗎？……我其實蠻喜歡橄欖的耶！

subtitles.en:
Haha, we are opposites again! What about you,
Mia? Any... any food you dislike?
subtitles.zh:
哈哈，我們又唱反調了！那妳呢，Mia？有沒有……有沒有什麼食物是妳討厭
的？

subtitles.en:
Hmm, I don't like spicy food. Hot food is...
definitely not for me!
subtitles.zh: 嗯，我不喜歡吃辣。辣的食物……絕對不適合我！

subtitles.en:
What about daily activities? ...Is there
anything you dislike?
subtitles.zh: 那日常活動呢？……有什麼是妳不喜歡的嗎？

subtitles.en:
Oh, I don't like waking up early. I am
definitely... not a morning person!
subtitles.zh: 喔，我不喜歡早起。我絕對……不是一個晨型人！

subtitles.en:
Haha, I totally agree! Getting enough sleep
is... just so important.
subtitles.zh: 哈哈，我完全同意！睡眠充足……真的太重要了。

subtitles.en:
What about you, Alex? What... what activity
do you dislike?
subtitles.zh: 那你呢，Alex？有什麼……什麼活動是你討厭的？

subtitles.en:
I don't like waiting in long lines. It is...
oh, so boring!
subtitles.zh: 我不喜歡排長隊。那真的……喔，太無聊了！

subtitles.en:
Haha! Well, nobody likes waiting in long
lines!
subtitles.zh: 哈哈！嗯，確實沒人喜歡排長隊！

subtitles.en:
See? When you put these simple pieces
together... you have a complete, natural
introduction!
subtitles.zh:
看吧？當妳把這些簡單的部分拼湊在一起……就成了一段完整又自然的自我介紹
了！

subtitles.en:
For example, I could say... 'Hi, I'm Alex.
I'm an English teacher. I love dogs, pizza,
and... well, rock music! But... I don't like
waiting in line.'
subtitles.zh:
「例如，我可以說：『嗨，我是 Alex。我是一名英文老師。
我喜歡狗、披薩，還有……嗯，搖滾樂！但是……我不喜歡排隊。』」

subtitles.en:
And I can say... 'Hi, I'm Mia. I'm an art
student. I love cats, pasta, and painting...
but, oh, I don't like waking up early!'
subtitles.zh:
「而我可以說：『嗨，我是 Mia。我是一名美術系學生。
我喜歡貓、義大利麵和畫畫……但是，噢，我討厭早起！』」

subtitles.en:
See? It's simple, authentic... and, well,
full of personality!
subtitles.zh: 「看吧？這既簡單、道地……而且，嗯，充滿了個人特色！」

subtitles.en:
Wow... time flies when you're having fun!
We—well, we covered so many useful phrases
today.
subtitles.zh:
「哇……快樂的時光總是過得特別快！我們——嗯，
我們今天學了好多實用的句子呢。」

subtitles.en:
Now, it's your turn to practice! Here is...
today's Daily Challenge!
subtitles.zh: 「現在，輪到你們練習囉！這就是……今天的每日挑戰！」

subtitles.en:
We really, really want to get to know you!
So... please answer in the comments below:
subtitles.zh: 「我們真的、真的很想認識大家！所以……請在下方的留言區回答我們：」

subtitles.en:
Tell us... 'What do you do?'—or, share one
favorite thing, and one dislike!
subtitles.zh:
「告訴我們……『你是做什麼工作的？』——或者，
分享一個你最喜歡的東西，和一個你討厭的事情！」

subtitles.en:
Yeah! You can write... 'I am a student', 'I
am a nurse'... or even, 'I love pizza and
dogs'!
subtitles.zh:
「對啊！你可以寫……『我是一名學生』、『我是一名護理師』……或者甚至是
，『我喜歡披薩和狗』！」

subtitles.en:
Oh! Alex and I will personally read your
comments... and give hearts to our favorites!
subtitles.zh:
「噢！Alex 和我會親自閱讀你們的留言……並給我們最喜歡的留言點愛心
喔！」

subtitles.en:
And... don't forget to check the description
box below! You can use our free tools to
practice—well, everything we learned today.
subtitles.zh:
「還有……別忘了查看下方的說明欄！你可以使用我們的免費工具來練習——嗯
，我們今天學到的所有內容。」

subtitles.en:
Yes! Whether it's intensive listening... or
one-on-one AI speaking... it's all completely
free! Go give it a try!
subtitles.zh:
「沒錯！不論是精聽練習……還是一對一的 AI 口說練習……全部都是完全
免費的！快去試試看吧！」

subtitles.en:
If you enjoyed today's video... please like,
subscribe to the AB English Podcast, and
share with your friends!
subtitles.zh:
「如果你喜歡今天的影片……請按讚、訂閱 AB 英文播客，
並分享給你的朋友們！」

subtitles.en:
Thank you so much for learning with us today.
Remember...
subtitles.zh: 「非常謝謝你今天和我們一起學習。請記住……」

subtitles.en: Always... Better... Everyday!
subtitles.zh: 「每天都要變得更好！」

subtitles.en: See you next time!
subtitles.zh: 「我們下次見！」

subtitles.en: See you next time! Bye-bye!
subtitles.zh: 「下次見囉！拜拜！」
